input.quote: (b) Licensee agrees to allow an independent Certified Public Accountant or other Audit Professional, (selected by mutual agreement) to audit and analyze appropriate accounting records to ensure compliance with all terms of this Agreement. Any such audit shall be permitted by Licensee within 30 days of Licensee's receipt of a written request of Licensor.
input.rationale: The audit right binding us (Licensee) sits in Article II.IV(b) (p0073), with cost allocation at p0064. Several elements already meet the preferred position: the auditor must be an independent CPA/audit professional selected by mutual agreement, the scope is limited to accounting records (no access to our systems), we get a 30-day lead time from Licensor's written request, and Licensor bears the cost unless a discrepancy over 5% is found. However, there is no frequency limit at all, so Licensor could demand audits repeatedly — unlimited audits fall in walk-away territory under this rule and fail the fallback's "once per year" requirement. The clause is also silent on business hours and on binding the auditor to confidentiality. We therefore proposed the minimal insert capping audits at one per twelve months, on 30 days' prior written notice, during normal business hours, with the auditor bound by confidentiality; the 5% cost-shift threshold and records-only scope are left untouched.

proposal.summary: Cap audits at once per 12 months, during business hours, on 30 days' notice, with the auditor bound by confidentiality.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have capped these record audits at once per twelve months, during normal business hours and on 30 days' prior written notice, and required the auditor to be bound by confidentiality, consistent with our policy against open-ended audit rights. The 5% cost-shift threshold and the records-only scope are unchanged.

ops.oldText: Any such audit shall be permitted by Licensee within 30 days of Licensee's receipt of a written request of Licensor.
ops.newText: Any such audit shall be permitted by Licensee within 30 days of Licensee's receipt of a written request of Licensor, provided that (i) no more than one (1) such audit may be conducted in any twelve (12) month period, (ii) Licensor shall give Licensee not less than thirty (30) days' prior written notice of the audit, (iii) the audit shall be conducted during Licensee's normal business hours in a manner that does not unreasonably interfere with Licensee's operations, and (iv) the auditor shall be bound by written confidentiality obligations no less protective than those in this Agreement.
